description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9, §5.10): the toll-riders' siege line - hired by Aldmere - sets up east of Skarn Steading and bombards its three longhouses (its engines' prop_targets: props tagged house). It starts once: after Ulfra's plea (world.skarn.plea_accepted, stage 5) or when a stage-6 giant comes to Skarn, with Skarn's chunk loaded and the giant within 200 m. Its engines appear as it starts (ConditionSpawn on event.siege_of_skarn.runs) and hold their fire while the giant is more than 200 m from Skarn (bombard_within_m: the siege's clock pauses); their shots burn the longhouses they aim at (M8 gate). Its fail timer is a backstop for a line that cannot burn them: 600 s of the giant within 200 m of Skarn (fail.within_m) and Skarn burns. Saved: every member of the line beaten or routed (the line routs when its last engine falls) before two longhouses burn - 300 XP and 1 titan iron through quest.siege_of_skarn, Skarn's support and its hearth-forge. Burned: two longhouses fall (at least two stay burned until quest.skarn_rebuild raises them).

objective.text: Save Skarn: break the siege line's engines ({standing} of {total} longhouses stand)

start_text: The toll-riders' siege line opens fire on Skarn!
respawn_text: The siege of Skarn goes on.

saved.text: Skarn is saved: the siege line breaks and flees.

burned.text: Skarn burns: the siege line has fired its halls.
